Vacancy for Head Cook
Monday, 22 November 2021
4941 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital invites applications on plain paper for the post of Head Cook (Category - Open). the application along with attested copies of educational qualification and experience should reach to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha  442102 on or before
30
th
November, 2021
.
Qualification & Experience
:
H.S.C. + Diploma in Hotel Operation with proficiency in Cooking. Must have worked as a cook in  500 bedded Hospital/Organization with at least 500 employees for minimum 2 years .
Note
: Age Limit:  Age 18 – 43 for reserved candidate and 18- 38 years for open candidate.
Age and Experience can be relaxed for an exceptional and suitable candidate.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
